_comment: Weekly mutation run (.github/workflows/quality-mutation.yml), never on an ordinary pull request. Mutates the CLI sources; tui.ts is left out because it drives an interactive terminal its tests barely reach. thresholds.break is the gate: the run fails below it. It sits just under the score measured when the gate was added and only moves up. inPlace: the catalog tests read ../loops, which a sandbox copy of cli/ does not have.
